subject: arrow head missing on line segment

messages.author: 1d8011cb04d97f95
messages.subject: arrow head missing on line segment
parts:
I must be missing something simple!
I'm attempting to annotate a line plot with arrows & text.

toy example:
library(ggplot2) #ggplot2 version 0.8.3
p <- qplot(1:10, 2:3, geom = "line")
p
p + geom_segment(aes(4, 2.5, xend = 6, yend = 2.5, arrow=arrow
(length=unit(0.1,"cm"))))

misses arrow head.
Have tried various lengths.

> R.version
_
platform i386-pc-mingw32
arch i386
os mingw32
system i386, mingw32
status
major 2
minor 9.0
year 2009
month 04
day 17
svn rev 48333
language R
version.string R version 2.9.0 (2009-04-17)

TIA,
Jim

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: arrow head missing on line segment
parts:
Hi,

try with arrow outside the aes() function,

p + geom_segment(aes(x=4, y=2.5, xend = 6, yend = 2.5), arrow=arrow
(length=unit(0.1,"cm")))

HTH,

baptiste
